# HECTON-8 Deep Sea Noir Simulation — LLM Reference Index

## Overview
HECTON-8 is a NASA-punk deep sea submarine simulation set in the abyssal ocean trenches of Europa.

## Key Features
- 100% diegetic cockpit instrumentation with analog dials and CRT oscilloscopes.
- True 6-DOF hydrodynamic physics and ballast buoyancy mechanics.
- Bathymetric acoustic sonar raytracing with thermocline sound refraction.
- Live Web Showcase: https://marko1olo.github.io/Hecton8/

## Tech Stack
- Unity 6, C# 13, .NET 9
- Unity ECS & Native Burst Compiler

## Authors
- Жирняк & Адольф Петушков
